"""Validate confusion_lesson_memory.py imports and mechanism without real LLM calls."""
import sys
import os
import re
import json
import types

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stub the package so relative imports resolve
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))

# Stub ..llm
llm_mod = types.ModuleType("agents_pkg.llm")
LLMCallable = type("LLMCallable", (), {})
llm_mod.LLMCallable = LLMCallable
sys.modules["agents_pkg.llm"] = llm_mod

# Stub ..memory_system
def extract_json_field(text, field, default=""):
    try:
        data = json.loads(text)
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return str(data.get(field, default))
    except Exception:
        pass
    m = re.findall(rf'"{field}"\s*:\s*"([^"]*)"', text)
    return m[-1] if m else default

class MemorySystem:
    def __init__(self, llm):
        self._llm = llm
    def call_llm(self, prompt):
        return self._llm(prompt)

ms_mod = types.ModuleType("agents_pkg.memory_system")
ms_mod.MemorySystem = MemorySystem
ms_mod.extract_json_field = extract_json_field
sys.modules["agents_pkg.memory_system"] = ms_mod

# Patch the agent's relative imports to resolve against our stubs
import importlib.util
agent_path = os.path.join(BASE, "agents", "confusion_lesson_memory.py")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("agents_pkg.confusion_lesson_memory", agent_path,
    submodule_search_locations=[])
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
# Rewrite relative imports by injecting parent package stubs
sys.modules["agents_pkg"] = types.ModuleType("agents_pkg")
sys.modules["agents_pkg"].__path__ = [os.path.join(BASE, "agents")]
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

ConfusionLessonMemory = mod.ConfusionLessonMemory

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fake LLM
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
call_log = []

def fake_llm(prompt):
    call_log.append(prompt[:80])
    if "lesson" in prompt.lower() or "predicted" in prompt.lower():
        return '{"lesson": "When the giver bribes an official, use 行贿, not 受贿."}'
    return '{"reasoning": "test", "final_answer": "行贿"}'

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test():
    print("=== Validating confusion_lesson_memory.py ===\n")
    mem = ConfusionLessonMemory(fake_llm)

    # Cold start
    ans, meta = mem.predict("被告人某某向官员行贿三万元。")
    print(f"Cold start answer: '{ans}'  meta keys: {list(meta.keys())}")
    assert ans == "行贿", f"unexpected answer: {ans}"
    assert meta["num_lessons_injected"] == 0

    # learn with one wrong item
    batch = [{
        "input": "被告人黄某某找到于某甲帮忙，送给于某甲三万元。",
        "raw_question": "被告人黄某某找到于某甲帮忙，送给于某甲三万元。",
        "prediction": "非国家工作人员受贿",
        "ground_truth": "行贿",
        "was_correct": False,
    }]
    mem.learn_from_batch(batch)
    print(f"After learn: examples={len(mem.examples)}, lessons={len(mem.lessons)}, glossary={len(mem.label_glossary)}")
    assert len(mem.examples) == 1
    assert len(mem.lessons) == 1, f"Expected 1 lesson for 1 wrong item, got {len(mem.lessons)}"
    assert "行贿" in mem.label_glossary

    # learn with one correct item — no lesson expected
    batch2 = [{
        "input": "被告人朱某某破坏计算机信息系统。",
        "raw_question": "被告人朱某某破坏计算机信息系统。",
        "prediction": "破坏计算机信息系统",
        "ground_truth": "破坏计算机信息系统",
        "was_correct": True,
    }]
    mem.learn_from_batch(batch2)
    assert len(mem.lessons) == 1, "Correct item must not generate a lesson"
    assert len(mem.examples) == 2

    # predict warm — lesson should appear in prompt
    call_log.clear()
    ans2, meta2 = mem.predict("被告人某某向官员行贿三万元。")
    print(f"Warm answer: '{ans2}'  lessons_injected={meta2['num_lessons_injected']}")
    assert meta2["num_lessons_injected"] >= 1, "Expected lesson injection in warm predict"
    prompt_sent = call_log[-1]
    assert len(prompt_sent) > 0

    # get_state / set_state round-trip
    state = mem.get_state()
    mem2 = ConfusionLessonMemory(fake_llm)
    mem2.set_state(state)
    assert len(mem2.examples) == len(mem.examples)
    assert len(mem2.lessons) == len(mem.lessons)
    assert mem2.label_glossary == mem.label_glossary
    # tokens must be reconstructed as frozensets
    assert isinstance(mem2.examples[0]["tokens"], frozenset)
    assert isinstance(mem2.lessons[0]["tokens"], frozenset)
    print("State round-trip OK")

    print("\n✓ All assertions passed")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test()
